headlines.title: Susan Collins and Troy Jackson clash over Trump and seniority in Maine’s first Senate debate
headlines.description: The two candidates clashed repeatedly over their records and national politics in the first of four debates in the key battleground race.

headlines.title: NBC’s Steve Kornacki Breaks Down Where Midterm Numbers Stand
headlines.description: With midterm elections just a month away, NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki joins TODAY to discuss the latest poll numbers, where the Senate and the House stand, what battleground states to keep an eye on, the major issues on the minds of voters, and more.

headlines.title: Sally Yates, former acting attorney general who defied Trump, to lead Cornell investigation
headlines.description: The longtime federal prosecutor became known for refusing to enforce Trump’s ban on travelers to the U.S. from predominantly Muslim countries.

headlines.title: Christa Pike now conscious and speaking following failed execution
headlines.description: Christa Pike, a Tennessee inmate who was unconscious and on a ventilator after a failed execution, is now awake and speaking, according to her lawyers. In a statement, attorneys for Pike said she remains handcuffed and shackled.

headlines.title: Paramount Skydance completes $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros.
headlines.description: Paramount Skydance completed its $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros., creating a Hollywood heavyweight called Skydance and handing CEO David ‌Ellison control. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports on the details of the merger.

headlines.title: What Trump's new executive order on diesel means
headlines.description: President Trump signed an executive order aimed at bringing down diesel prices by easing restrictions on red-dye diesel. NBC News' Brian Cheung breaks down what is in the order and what it means for Americans.

headlines.title: Record Pacific temps fuel a ‘super’ El Niño with grave global consequences
headlines.description: Sea surface temperatures have spiked to record levels in the tropical Pacific this fall, a sign that El Niño continues to strengthen.

headlines.title: Live updates: The absolute best October Prime Day deals, hand-picked by a shopping reporter
headlines.description: NBC Selected editors are tracking the best October Prime Day deals live, with prices and recommendations updated throughout the event. Here’s what’s worth buying.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Zach Lahn’s residency history and Rob Sand’s party come under fire in first Iowa governor debate
headlines.description: Lahn, the Republican nominee, and Sand, the Democratic state auditor, are running to succeed retiring GOP Gov. Kim Reynolds.

headlines.title: Georgia governor candidates spar over the economy and Trump in lone debate
headlines.description: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms and Republican Rick Jackson clashed Tuesday night during their only scheduled debate of this fall’s race for governor in Georgia.

headlines.title: Fuel industry warns truck stops not to sell red dye diesel after Trump lifts restrictions
headlines.description: “We do not expect most reputable diesel retailers and fuel marketers to do this,” said several industry groups. “There’s limited upside.”
